description: Get a verified, versioned download for one asset: the immutable file URL, its SHA-256, and the slicing data. Optionally returns the PNG inline. Verify the checksum after saving.

inline.description: If true and the file is ≤ 1 MiB, also return the file as an embedded resource (base64). The server verifies the SHA-256 before returning it.

version.description: Omit for latest; the output pins the concrete version.

name: download

inline_verified.description: Present when inline=true; true means the embedded bytes matched sha256 on the server.
